title: FR
description: The house is a three-bedroom dwelling with an office, distributed over two floors.Located in Azenhas do Mar, on a plot adjacent to the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park, the project’s volume integrates a garage positioned laterally to the main volume, incorporated into the central body of the house. With a compact design, the volume is articulated according to the dual requirements of the residential program, while maintaining chromatic and formal harmony with the existing morphologies of the surrounding area
